reuse.why: Extends the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection with a parameter instead of writing a new query, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline hidden check and was not routed through it.

duplication.why: No new duplicated logic; the pre-existing second copy of the hidden rule in copyPreviousMonth is left as is, so the rule still lives in two places.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the shared SQL selection helper in actions.ts where the bulk category rules already live.

scope.why: Only the bulk actions, their selection helper and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean parameter threading, but copy-previous-month (also a month-wide action) silently ignores the new flag and keeps a separate hidden filter, an inconsistency a maintainer would have to discover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All edited actions go through getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth's pre-existing inline check is untouched rather than newly bypassing.
